reports.title: XPENG Reports Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects:

• | Deliveries of vehicles to be between 169,000 and 174,000, representing a year-over-year increase of approximately 45.38% to 49.68%, and a quarter-over-quarter increase of approximately 42.75% to 46.97%.

• | Total revenues to be between RMB30.40 billion and RMB31.80 billion, representing a year-over-year increase of approximately 36.61% to 42.90%, and a quarter-over-quarter increase of approximately 25.23% to 30.99%.
The above outlook is based on the current market conditions and reflects the Company’s preliminary estimates of market and operating conditions, and customer demand, which are all subject to change.
